up: List all compounds tested in the assay identified by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5483194, and for each compound provide its exact activity values: include the compound's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary) and preferred name (if available), along with the activity's standard_type (e.g., IC50, Ki, etc.), standard_relation (e.g., =, >, <), standard_value, standard_units, and pchembl_value (if available). Do not apply any additional filters; include all activity records for that assay.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5483194';
